SessionStats

class SessionStats(score_done=0, movement_done=0, collided_target=0, avoided_target=0, collided_obstacle=0, avoided_obstacle=0)[source]

Bases: object

Session totals (the whole game run), never reset.

score_done and movement_done accumulate the levels already closed; the session total is this accumulated value plus the value of the level in progress.

Attributes:
score_doneint

Score of the closed levels. Defaults to 0.

movement_doneint

Lane changes of the closed levels. Defaults to 0.

collided_targetint

Targets hit in the session. Defaults to 0.

avoided_targetint

Targets missed in the session. Defaults to 0.

collided_obstacleint

Obstacles hit in the session. Defaults to 0.

avoided_obstacleint

Obstacles avoided in the session. Defaults to 0.

Methods

close_level

Add the level score and lane changes to the accumulated ones.

totals

Return the session totals in the session row format (DAO).
close_level(level)[source]

Add the level score and lane changes to the accumulated ones.

Parameters:
levelLevelStats

Counters of the level being closed.

totals(level)[source]

Return the session totals in the session row format (DAO).

Parameters:
levelLevelStats

Counters of the level in progress, added to the accumulated score and movement.

Returns:
dict

general_score, q_movement, q_collided_target, q_avoided_target, q_collided_obstacle and q_avoided_obstacle.

Examples

>>> session = SessionStats(score_done=10, movement_done=4)
>>> totals = session.totals(LevelStats(score=5, movement=1))
>>> totals["general_score"], totals["q_movement"]
(15, 5)
